text:
mikaela: Heads-up — we're getting a burst of inbound signups from the May webinar page (utm=may_launch_series). HubSpot webhooks showing high latency and our enrichment endpoint is timing out. ~22 leads marked intake:unclaimed. Can we do a narrow mitigation so SDR handoffs still meet SLA?

devon: What's the failure mode — webhook retries or enrichment 5xx? Grafana shows webhook avg latency ~70s and enrichment 504s around 11:05.

alerts-bot: HubSpot webhook latency alert: avg 71s over last 10m. Enrichment 5xx spike at 11:05:12.

hari: Targeted only. Suggest rule: match utm_campaign contains "may_launch_series" AND enrichment_status==pending && pending_seconds > 6 -> assign owner "SDR-Webinar-Queue" + intake_flag {suppress_task:true, allow_partial:true, hs_fallback:true}. That avoids global blast radius.

olivia: OK but SF behavior? external_id dedupe prevents duplicate Leads, but owner changes still create tasks. suppress_task should reduce noise. I'll monitor for duplicates and task counts. Rollback if dup_rate > 2/min OR suppressed_tasks > 25 in 15m.

devon: I'll canary a small rule to staging. Curl for staging patch:
```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://internal-config.redwood/api/v1/lead-routing" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"round_robin": {"targeted_fallbacks": [{"match": {"utm_campaign_contains": "may_launch_series", "enrichment_status": "pending", "pending_seconds_gt": 6}, "owner": "SDR-Webinar-Queue", "intake_flags": {"suppress_task": true, "allow_partial": true}, "hs_fallback": "true"}]}}'
```

sam: I'll also bump enrichment DB pool +10 connections and add a short circuit breaker to fail-fast after connection saturation. That should reduce 5xx rate under burst.

mikaela: Action list: 1) devon -> deploy staging canary for the rule, smoke test, then prod. 2) sam -> increase DB pool and enable circuit breaker. 3) olivia -> monitor SF duplicates/tasks in #inbound-handoff and set heartbeat. 4) hari -> add HubSpot internal property hs_fallback=true and workflow note so SDRs know enrichment pending. 5) mikaela -> open postmortem ticket after surge.

jira-bot: Created JIRA-4110: "May webinar surge — intake fallback & enrichment hardening" assigned to mikaela.

devon: Canary applied to staging; running 40-event smoke. ETA ~90s.

alerts-bot: Staging smoke traffic shows targeted fallback triggering for utm match. No dup anomalies in staging simulation.

devon: Rolling to prod now. Patch applied at 11:08:02.

hari: HubSpot note template: "Partial intake (hs_fallback=true). Full enrichment in progress — do not re-create tasks." Pushed to workflow WF-0911.

olivia: Watching SF. Heartbeat: reporting every 5m in #inbound-handoff. I'll rollback if dup_rate > 2/min or suppressed_tasks > 25 within 15m.

sam: DB pool increase applied by sam at 11:09:15. Circuit breaker enabled (threshold connections=85%). Monitoring.

alerts-bot: Enrichment 5xx trending down after DB tweak. Webhook latency improving.

mikaela: First 15m check: suppressed tasks = 7, dup_rate = 0. No anomalies. Keep fallback for 45m then evaluate. Postmortem owners: mikaela, devon, sam. Thanks all. :rocket:
